description: Public documentation/interoperability vectors, not runtime implementation or provider qualification. Ephemeral independent publisher/verifier Ed25519 keys were generated once; only public JWKs and signatures are retained. No private seed is retained. All identities, service observations and policy inputs are fictional. Positive assessment is declaration-only, never official installed-code proof. Base positive is a production Axum declaration using dns-key-control-v1 in explicitly isolated synthetic protocol context. Optional fingerprint and official-shaped objects contain fictional methods/releases/digests; production_provider_qualification=false. No production provider method is qualified by these vectors.
encoding: JWS signing input is ASCII protected_segment + dot + payload_segment. Verify those exact segments. JSON bytes use sorted keys and compact ASCII-compatible serialization; fixture values use the RFC 8785-compatible integer/ASCII subset. Digests of signed objects hash exact compact ASCII bytes.
